'''Trent''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], he served as commander of the [[Regulator (starship)|''Regulator'']], serving the [[Rapid Response Task Force]] during the campaign against [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn]].
